title: Trifolium pratense cream for medicinal use
intro: Trifolium pratense cream is a topical herbal preparation made from red clover (Trifolium pratense), known for its anti-inflammatory and soothing properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to treat skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, and minor burns due to its high content of flavonoids and phytoestrogens. The cream is often applied directly to the affected area to reduce irritation and promote healing. It is also believed to support hormonal balance when used as part of a broader herbal regimen. This preparation is valued for its gentle yet effective approach to skin care and wellness.
